name: Particle Cannon
source: Starfinder Murder in Metal City Deluxe Adventure
description: A glowering purple eye opens in the ship's hull. The triple barrels of a massive turret spin inside the revealed port, then release a beam of concentrated particles with ruthless efficiency.
disable: DC 14 Crafting (trained) or DC 14 Thievery (trained) to disable or jam the particle cannon, DC 17 Arcana , DC 17 Occultism , DC 17 Nature , or DC 17 Religion (trained) to counteract the particle beam by exploiting a magical theory or praying for a miraculous malfunction.
reset: If disabled, the cannon is inactive for 1 round while Hura troubleshoots the issue, then it resumes firing. Hura stops firing if the lookouts are killed or the cannon is disabled three or more times.
routine: (2 actions) Hura fires a charged shot from the particle cannon, dealing (1d6+3) Fire Damage damage to each creature in a 90ft Type:line (Basic DC 14 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Charge Up
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A lookout identifies a threat

Effect Hura takes the gunner position. The particle cannon rolls initiative.
